interpretation: Training 281,431,040 additional parameters buys no demonstrable panel accuracy at this dose (p=0.8555) and costs four reference answers (37 kept vs 41). The measured seed-to-seed noise floor on this instrument is 15-24 discordant rows, so this comparison could not have resolved a small difference even if one existed; it rules out a large one.
note: Does training all 28 blocks beat training the last 20, at identical dose, seed, schedule and learning rate? Paired McNemar on the 150-row panel, exact two-sided binomial over discordant rows only. Both arms are the float32 checkpoints; the published BF16 Opallo core is measured separately in PANEL.json.
